title: Console cardinal navigation grid: reduce surface friction for dashboards & workspace switching
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Objective: Rework the Console information architecture to make key flows—dashboards, rollouts, and cost views—discoverable within two clicks while preserving low-latency access to workspace context. Proposal: a cardinal navigation grid that groups primary surfaces into four cardinal zones (Overview, Workspaces, Models, Operations) with a lightweight contextual micro-rail for in-place workspace switching. This ticket covers high-fidelity prototypes, heuristic reviews, and a handoff package for engineering to implement the grid and micro-rail transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Primary surfaces reachable within two interactions from any Console entry point
Workspace switch completes in <150ms perceived transition (prototype target) and preserves route-scoped filters
Cost and rollout panels surface top-line metrics in the Overview quadrant with direct deep-links to per-route breakdowns
Design handoff includes responsive states for collapsed/expanded rails and accessible keyboard navigation (tab order documented)
Stakeholder sign-off from PM, Eng (runtime), and Accessibility review recorded in comments
decisions: Adopt quadrant-first layout rather than a single monolithic left rail to surface cross-cutting metrics
Keep workspace switcher as context-sensitive micro-rail (flyout on hover/click) instead of full-screen modal to preserve continuity
Expose route-level deep-links in the Overview quadrant to enable direct sharing of rollout and cost views
Defer multi-tenant workspace bulk-actions to a follow-up ticket (scope limit for MVP)
tradeoffs: Quadrant grid improves discoverability but uses more horizontal space; mitigated with a compact collapse and adaptive layout
Micro-rail preserves context but adds surface complexity for edge cases (nested workspaces); additional QA required
Surface-first focus may require runtime changes for route resolution—ENG dependency and temporary client-side redirects included in scope
